Artifact.Name: The Hive Navigator
Artifact.Description: Though originally designed to lure Hive ships to their doom, this computer has been repurposed to help ships avoid an enemy's targeting technology. Though this device appears ancient and damaged, it provides potent protection, even in today's dangerous galaxy.

Artifact.Name: Grudgehold Recordings Box Set
Artifact.Description: It might be a challenge to find a modern video playback device compatible with these recordings, but it would be well worth the effort. The evidence of pirates forcing politicians, oligarchs, and noblemen to fight to the death represents a powerful reminder of the dangers and possibilities of anarchy. Surely visitors would come from the furthest reaches of the galaxy to watch these recordings.

Artifact.Name: Remnant of the Last Remnant
Artifact.Description: In the years following the Shakturi War, the Last Remnant continued to fight against the last vestiges of the Shaktur Axis. Ragtag bands of Freedom Alliance survivors would often resort to unspeakable means to harass any enemy. This device allowed them to more easily defeat dangerous (or lucrative) targets.

Artifact.Name: The Ambushers' Secret
Artifact.Description: This data crystal once belonged to the Ambushers, a pirate clan dedicated to lightning attacks from hidden bases. It remains useful for avoiding detection and will be prized by any ship’s captain who understands the power of stealth.

Artifact.Name: The Empty Throne
Artifact.Description: This is the throne of an ancient pirate king. The chair is large and ornately decorated, clearly designed to impart a sense of authority and majesty.

Artifact.Name: The Instructor
Artifact.Description: This machine, with its complex neural relays that attach directly to the user’s skull, suggests a truly alien aesthetic and may be based on technology that originates in another galaxy. The device’s strange contours and lack of symmetry make some observers feel uncomfortable.

Artifact.Name: Hive-Pattern Tracker
Artifact.Description: This is a portion of a sensor array that was designed to track the movement of Hive ships. Now that the device has been modified and is ready to be integrated into modern sensor systems, where it should improve combat targeting.

Artifact.Name: Echo of the Builders
Artifact.Description: A mainframe containing the databanks of an ancient pirate faction known as the Builders. This is an ordinary looking computing device, but it contains a treasure trove of architectural knowledge.
